connect-intro: Subscribe to your plan in Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar, follow it in any RSS reader, and get tonight’s lineup and your progress posted to a Discord channel. Everything updates by itself as you tick titles off.
connect-privacy: This saves a copy of your plan on RMH Studios under a private, unguessable link. No account needed. Anyone with the calendar or RSS link can see your watch list, but only this browser can change it. You can turn it off any time, which deletes the copy.
copy-failed: Couldn’t copy — your browser blocked the clipboard.
custom-hint: Sony’s Spider-Man films, the Fox X-Men, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., the Netflix Defenders — anything you want in the run.
device-copied: Link copied. Open it on your other device — keep it private, it can edit your plan.
discord-daily: Post tonight’s lineup an hour before I start
discord-hint: In Discord: Channel Settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL, then paste it here. Great for a watch-party server.
discord-progress: Post when I finish titles and phases

empty-plan: Nothing to schedule. Tick some titles in the watch list below to build a plan.
finale-dune: Paul’s story continues. Two films to rewatch.
finale-mcu: The MCU’s next team-up. Every film and series counts.
footer-made: Made at RMH Studios · Best viewed with a bowl of popcorn
footer-note: Runtimes are theatrical cuts; series totals marked ≈ are estimates — tap any runtime to correct it. Your plan is saved in this browser only. A fan-made planner, not affiliated with Marvel Studios, Disney, Legendary or Warner Bros.
ics-done: Calendar file downloaded — open it to add every night.
ie-cannot-display: Internet Explorer cannot display the webpage
ie-ext-heading: This website is outside the sandbox
ie-ext-open: Open in a new browser tab
ie-ext-text: Dunesday 7 doesn’t load other websites inside itself. You can open {{host}} in a real browser tab instead — it won’t be able to see anything on this desktop.
ie-invalid-text: This sandboxed browser only opens web addresses (http:// and https://) and its own about: pages. Check the address and try again.
ie-nothing-next: Nothing scheduled — you’re all caught up.
ie-sb-1: Dunesday 7 is a pretend computer that lives entirely in this browser tab. Its files, settings and window positions are saved in this browser only (local storage, about 3 MB) and never leave it.
ie-sb-2: The logon screen accepts any password because there is nothing to protect: the password is thrown away the moment you press Enter. Your RMH Studios account picture and name are shown if you’re signed in to the site.
ie-sb-3: This browser can show built-in pages and pages on RMH Studios. Other websites are never loaded inside it — you can choose to open them in a real browser tab instead.
ie-sb-4: The only thing that talks to a server is the marathon itself: the Messenger assistant, and the optional cloud sync, calendar feed and Discord updates in Sync Center.
ie-self-text: Dunesday 7 can’t be opened inside Dunesday 7 — it would be computers all the way down. Try another page on RMH Studios.
ie-try-1: Retype the address, for example /blog or rmhstudios.com/news.
impossible: Even round-the-clock viewing can’t fit it all before {{deadline}}. Trim the list.

sol-about-body: Klondike Solitaire for the Dunesday desktop. Build the four foundations up from Ace to King by suit; build the tableau down in alternating colours.
sol-about-keys: Drag cards, or click one to send it to its best place. Keyboard: Tab or arrow keys between piles, Enter to pick up and Enter to drop, H for a hint, Ctrl+Z to undo, F2 for a new game.
sol-confirm-body: The new draw setting starts a new game. This game will count as a loss.
sol-hint-stock: Hint: turn a card from the stock.
sol-no-hint: No more moves. Try Undo or start a new game.
sol-recycled: Waste turned back into the stock.
sp-about-body: Spider Solitaire for the Dunesday desktop. Build down from King to Ace in one suit to clear a run; clear all eight runs to win.
sp-about-keys: Drag cards, or click one to send it to its best place. Click the stock to deal a row. Keyboard: Tab or arrow keys between piles, Enter to pick up and Enter to drop, H for a hint, Ctrl+Z to undo, F2 for a new game.
sp-confirm-body: Changing the difficulty starts a new game. This game will count as a loss.
sp-deal-blocked: You can't deal while a column is empty.
sp-hint-stock: Hint: deal a new row from the stock.
sp-no-hint: No more moves. Try Undo or start a new game.
split-films-hint: Endgame in two sittings instead of one 3-hour night.
sync-disable-confirm: Click again — links will stop working
sync-error: Couldn’t save — will retry on your next change
sync-failed: Couldn’t turn sync on. Try again in a moment.
sync-lost: Your synced copy no longer exists, so sync was turned off. Your plan is still here.
sync-off: Sync is off and the online copy is deleted.
sync-on: Sync is on. Your calendar, RSS and Discord links are ready.
sync-restored: Synced plan loaded on this device.
tagline: Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three open the same day. Pick your start date and your pace, and get a night-by-night plan that finishes every film and show before the lights go down.
